description: This file defines a SwiftUI View component 'TailscaleIntegrationSection' that provides a user interface for managing Tailscale integration settings, including installation status, operational modes, access URLs, and authentication options. It also contains internal logic to load and save configuration, apply user settings, and monitor Tailscale status.

classes.name: GatewayTailscaleMode
classes.description: An enum representing the Tailscale modes: off, serve, and funnel, with associated raw values, labels, and descriptions.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI View providing UI and logic for Tailscale integration management within the app.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads existing Tailscale configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates inputs, updates configuration, and applies changes for Tailscale settings.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Constructs and saves the Tailscale and gateway configuration based on user selections.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Restarts the gateway if in local mode and not paused to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Sets up a periodic timer to check Tailscale status.
